bucket_note: Open record-level points exist (HDOT_Crash_Layer, no login), so the 2026-11-02 screen undercounted; but they carry the year only, no KABCO, no streets/route/milepost, no report number, and state roads only before 2023. Not enough for a pack without inventing dates and severity. Full data (SHACA) is by request.

blockers: open layers give the year only, no date
no KABCO severity (one undocumented 'major injury' flag)
state roads only 2015-2022; county roads from 2023
no street names, route or milepost; no report number
use limited to 'highway safety and educational purposes' (no paid-use grant)
user_actions: Ask HDOT Traffic Safety (SHACA) for a statewide 2019-2024 export with crash date, KABCO per crash, route+milepost or street names, report number, and written permission for paid use
Or ask HDOT to add date and KABCO severity to the open HDOT_Crash_Layer (it already has GPS on 99.9%)
